description.value: A tidy private campground nestled in cedar trees 12 minutes from downtown Vernon on the Silver Star Road corridor, offering flush showers, device charging, and free Wi-Fi; BX Creek Falls hiking trail is a short walk from the exit gate.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides clear evidence for most fields. OSM contact details (phone, address, website) are directly corroborated by the contact page. Amenity values are drawn from explicit website text and guest review passages; OSM tags internet_access=yes and power_supply=yes are noted but not used as standalone confirmation per rules. No hiker/biker-specific sites, device charging stations, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Cedar Falls is an active, well-reviewed campground with online booking, showers, and proximity to Silver Star Mountain biking — a clear fit for touring cyclists in the North Okanagan.

wow_evidence: flush showers, device charging, and free Wi-Fi
